steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to Auction with the default rank-based reverse-auction configuration.
Select a reverse buy-auction template so the product sheet is available.
Add the requested product as the first line item with quantity 10.
Complete the pricing sheet fields required by the selected template.

args.goal: On the auction configuration screen, set Tick Size to 0 and leave the configured event ready for the remaining participant and schedule steps.

steps.note: Set the tick size, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Add the two QA test vendors required by the case without inventing vendor names.
Attempt Publish Event and assert that publishing is refused with the application message “Invalid Tick Size”.
